<function name="MsgN" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Same as <page>Global.print</page>, except it concatinates the arguments without inserting any whitespace in between them.

See also <page>Global.Msg</page>, which doesn't add a newline (`"\n"`) at the end.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="args" type="vararg">List of values to print. They can be of any type and will be converted to strings with <page>Global.tostring</page>.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prints "Hello, World!" in two lines to the console.</description>
	<code>
MsgN("Hello,")
MsgN("World!")
	</code>
	<output>
```
Hello,
World!
```
	</output>

</example>
